question: Which of our commercial lending clients also have more than $5 million of capital-markets credit exposure, and what is each one's combined exposure?
answer:
I found **24 obligor groups** that borrow from us and also have more than $5 million of capital-markets credit exposure. Their combined exposure is **$2,746.5M**: $2,325.6M of active loan commitments plus $421.0M of capital-markets exposure. **Halvorsen Industrial Group is over its internal limit.** Its $344.3M is 115% of its $300M limit and 96% of the $360M legal lending limit, leaving $15.7M of room.

I measured at the obligor-group level, not per client number. Bank policy treats the parent company plus every company it currently controls as one customer for credit purposes (rule BR-CUST-01). Capital-markets exposure is the positive mark-to-market value at 2026-09-30, not notional.

($M. Every member of these groups is an active client and each group has active loans.)

**Other findings**
- **Halvorsen needs Senior Credit Committee approval**, because exposure above the internal limit goes there (rule BR-DLA-01). With only $15.7M left under the legal lending limit, it can't take much more credit.
- **11 groups only pass the $5M test when you add up their companies.** No single company in these groups is over $5M: Glenhaven, Norwell Ridge, Ravensholm River, Alderwick, Thornbury Group, Ivorline Capital, Thornbury Bay, Pellmont, Fenmoor, Harrowgate Holdings and Pinecrest Holdings. Looking only at individual client numbers, you would find just 15 clients in 13 groups.
- **13 of the 24 groups have no internal limit on file.** That includes five groups with more than $100M of combined exposure: Pinecrest Valley, Harrowgate Ridge, Norwell Ridge, Ravensholm River and Thornbury Bay. They should have limits set.
- **Five trading counterparties are over $5M but aren't lending clients, so they're left out.** Together they hold $86.9M: Moorcroft Global Opportunities Fund LP ($26.4M), Pinecrest Macro Fund LP ($19.1M), Moorcroft Macro Fund LP ($18.0M), Brandvold Macro Fund LP ($15.2M) and Hollinsby Capital Markets LLC ($8.3M). None has a client number, and none is controlled by any group. Their names look like some of our borrowers, but they aren't related.
- **Several groups have similar names but are separate, so I kept them apart.** Examples are Pinecrest Valley, Pinecrest Bay and Pinecrest Holdings, or Thornbury Group and Thornbury Bay.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Metrics (knowledge layer):**
  - `cm_current_exposure`: total current exposure at the latest month-end (2026-09-30) only. Notional and earlier snapshots are not counted.
  - `group_exposure` (rule BR-EXP-01): commitments of active facilities, including standby letters of credit, plus capital-markets exposure.
  - `limit_utilization`: combined exposure divided by the group's internal limit.
- **Group membership:** rule BR-CUST-01 and the approved ownership path. I followed current, controlling ownership links in `RISK_DEMO.dbo.OWNERSHIP` up to 8 levels (the deepest was 7). Minority stakes and sold companies are excluded. The memberships match the governed `obligor_groups` reference list, and I didn't use the deprecated `CPTY_HIER_LEGACY` table.
- **Tables:**
  - Fabric: `dbo.CM_EXPOSURE`, `dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY` (client numbers padded to 10 digits to match Snowflake), `dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT`
  - Snowflake: `BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT`, `BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY`
- **Limits:** the $360M legal lending limit is from rule BR-LLL-01.
- **Assumptions:**
  - "Commercial lending client" means a group with at least one active client that has an active facility.
  - The $5M test is applied to the group's total capital-markets exposure.
  - Exposure is gross: no guarantees are deducted.

sql.sql: SELECT SNAP_DT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT ENTITY_ID) ents, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT ORDER BY SNAP_DT

SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF, e.ce, e.trades
FROM (SELECT ENTITY_ID, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, COUNT(*) trades FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT = (SELECT MAX(SNAP_DT) FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE) GROUP BY ENTITY_ID) e
LEFT JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID = e.ENTITY_ID
WHERE e.ce > 5000000 ORDER BY e.ce DESC

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_TO >= '2026-09-30' AND EFF_FROM <= '2026-09-30'),
up AS (
SELECT le.ENTITY_ID e, COALESCE(o8.p,o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,le.ENTITY_ID) up_id,
 CASE WHEN o8.p IS NOT NULL THEN 8 WHEN o7.p IS NOT NULL THEN 7 WHEN o6.p IS NOT NULL THEN 6 WHEN o5.p IS NOT NULL THEN 5 WHEN o4.p IS NOT NULL THEN 4 WHEN o3.p IS NOT NULL THEN 3 WHEN o2.p IS NOT NULL THEN 2 WHEN o1.p IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END lvl
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le
LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=le.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p
LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p LEFT JOIN o o8 ON o8.c=o7.p),
cm AS (SELECT ENTITY_ID, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT=(SELECT MAX(SNAP_DT) FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE) GROUP BY ENTITY_ID)
SELECT up.up_id, MAX(pn.ENTITY_NM) parent_nm, SUM(cm.ce) grp_cm, COUNT(cm.ENTITY_ID) cm_ents, COUNT(*) members, MAX(up.lvl) maxlvl,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o x WHERE x.c IN (SELECT e FROM up u2 WHERE u2.up_id=up.up_id)) dummy
FROM up LEFT JOIN cm ON cm.ENTITY_ID=up.e LEFT JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY pn ON pn.ENTITY_ID=up.up_id
GROUP BY up.up_id HAVING SUM(cm.ce) > 5000000 ORDER BY grp_cm DESC

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_TO >= '2026-09-30' AND EFF_FROM <= '2026-09-30'),
up AS (
SELECT le.ENTITY_ID e, le.CIF_REF, COALESCE(o8.p,o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,le.ENTITY_ID) up_id
FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le
LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=le.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p
LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p LEFT JOIN o o8 ON o8.c=o7.p),
cm AS (SELECT ENTITY_ID, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT=(SELECT MAX(SNAP_DT) FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE) GROUP BY ENTITY_ID),
g AS (SELECT up.up_id FROM up LEFT JOIN cm ON cm.ENTITY_ID=up.e GROUP BY up.up_id HAVING SUM(cm.ce) > 5000000)
SELECT up.up_id, STRING_AGG(CAST(up.CIF_REF AS VARCHAR(MAX)), ',') cifs, COUNT(up.CIF_REF) n_cif
FROM up JOIN g ON g.up_id=up.up_id WHERE up.CIF_REF IS NOT NULL GROUP BY up.up_id
SELECT CIF_NO, CLIENT_NM, SEGMENT_CD, CLIENT_STATUS FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT WHERE CLIENT_NM ILIKE ANY ('%Moorcroft%','%Brandvold%','%Macro Fund%','%Hollinsby Capital%','%Opportunities Fund%')

SELECT cl.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, cl.LIMIT_AMT FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT cl JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID=cl.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID WHERE cl.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID IN ('LE-10001','LE-10103','LE-10129','LE-10166','LE-10180','LE-10208','LE-10225','LE-10349','LE-10383','LE-10404','LE-10468','LE-10597','LE-10603','LE-10638','LE-10664','LE-10699','LE-10727','LE-10804','LE-10822','LE-10940','LE-10965','LE-10972','LE-11053','LE-11061')
